releases.name: Input Demo Recorder v0.2.0
releases.body:
* Added seed for random unity events setable.
     * It will save the seed used to record a demo and use the same seed when playing it back
     * You can now set a seed in tas files

* Re added TAS files!

releases.name: Input Demo Recorder v.1.0
releases.body:
* Adds the capability to record inputs, save them in a file and play them:

* Press the button `Record` to record your inputs
    * A timer will appear showing how long have you been recording
    * The button `Stop Recording` will appear, and pressing it stops the recording to it to be saved or replayed

* Press the button `Play Recorded Demo` to play the demo that you recorded when you hit the `Record` button
    * A timer will appear showing the time of the recording that is being played
    * The button `Stop Playingback` will appear, and pressing it stops the playback

* Press the button `Save Demo` to save the recorded demo from when you hit the  `Record` button, use the text box that defaults to *OuterWilds_Demo* to choose the name of the file, it will be saved in the same folder as the mod's folder

* Press the button `Play Saved Demo` to play a demo saved into a file, use the text box that defaults to *OuterWilds_Demo* to choose the name of the file, it needs to be in the same folder as the mod's folder

* When loading or saving demos you don't need to specify the file extension as they will always use the extension `.owdemo`

* This is a BepInEx plugin which works with the 1.0.10 version of Outer Wilds
